 - Share market feedback and customer requirements with management. 
 - Track sales pipeline, conversion status and pending opportunities. 
 - Submit regular performance reports within the agreed timeline. 
 F. Team Support 
 - Assist the Business Development Manager in planning sales activities. 
 - Coordinate with sales executives and other departments. 
 - Support product training and sales presentations when required. 
 - Help new team members understand company products and sales processes. 
 - Contribute ideas for improving sales and customer acquisition.

 - Graduate degree or equivalent practical experience preferred.

 - Knowledge of hardware fittings, furniture fittings, modular kitchen products or related industries will be an advantage.

 - Ability to develop dealer and customer relationships. 
 - Basic knowledge of MS Excel, WhatsApp, email and CRM tools. 
 - Willingness to travel within the assigned territory. 
 - Self-motivated, disciplined and target-oriented approach. 
 - Ability to work independently and coordinate with the management team.

 Performance may be evaluated on the basis of: 
 - New dealer and customer acquisition. 
 - Genuine enquiries and qualified leads generated. 
 - Sales revenue and eligible sales achieved. 
 - Repeat orders and customer retention. 
 - Payment collection and credit-policy compliance. 
 - CRM accuracy and timely reporting. 
 - Market coverage and customer visits. 
 - Contribution to business expansion. 
 Targets will be mutually discussed and documented according to the assigned territory, working arrangement and available resources. 
 5. Compensation & Incentives 
 The compensation structure will be discussed based on the candidate’s experience, responsibilities and engagement model.

 - Fixed salary, if agreed in writing. 
 - Commission on eligible sales. 
 - Performance-based incentives. 
 - Approved travel expenses, where applicable. 
 - Commission payment according to the company’s written policy. 
 Important: Commission eligibility, calculation method, payment timing, treatment of returns, cancellations and unpaid credit sales will be clearly communicated before the engagement begins.

Your territory is the industrial heart of your city: NCR: Faridabad, IMT Manesar, Okhla, Noida, Sahibabad, Bhiwadi. The back doors — machine dealers, CAs, suppliers, bank RMs, ex-Tally/Marg partners, association circles. You recruit them as introducers (they earn on every deal they bring), keep them warm, and own this channel. Referral chains — every conversation, even the rejections, ends with “Which owner-friend of yours has this same problem?” You'll sell shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders : you get us into the room and own the relationship; founders run the demo and the close — for now. Street smart over MBA smart — you know who the real decision-maker is, who influences them, and how to move both Trusted first, then bought from — because you're genuinely curious, not because you read a sales book Fluent Hindi, own vehicle, already living in your city's industrial world Hungry: you've hit the ceiling where you are, and you want a job where the ceiling is yours to set You don't need polished English, a SaaS background, ji or an MBA. Weve secured our foundational clients, and now we are expanding into broader healthcare territories. We are looking for an ambitious, results-driven Business Development Manager (BDM) who doesn't just want a job, but wants to actively shape our companys future and grow into leadership alongside us. 
 The Role: 
If you have a proven track record in Medical Billing, Healthcare Sales, or Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) , this is your opportunity to take full ownership of a growing pipeline. You will be the driving force behind our market expansion, turning strategic opportunities into long-term partnerships. 
 The primary responsibility of this position is to generate new business and acquire new healthcare clients for our medical billing services . We are looking for someone who understands the U.S. healthcare market and can identify, approach, and convert physicians, medical practices, clinics, and healthcare organizations into long-term clients. This is a sales-focused position , and success will be measured primarily by qualified leads, meetings scheduled, proposals generated, and new clients signed.

Prospect physicians, medical practices, clinics, urgent care centers, specialty practices, and other healthcare organizations. Conduct outbound prospecting through phone calls, email, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and other appropriate channels. Connect with physicians, practice owners, practice managers, administrators, and other decision-makers. Schedule qualified sales meetings and discovery calls. Understand prospective clients' current billing challenges and identify opportunities where Alastor can provide solutions. Present Alastor's medical billing and RCM services professionally. Prepare and follow up on proposals and service opportunities. Maintain consistent follow-up with prospective clients throughout the sales cycle. Develop referral relationships and strategic partnerships that can generate new business. Maintain an organized sales pipeline and provide regular updates on leads, meetings, proposals, and conversions. Work closely with management and the operations team during client onboarding. Monitor competitors and identify new opportunities within the medical billing and RCM market. 
 Target Clients The BDM will primarily target: Independent physicians Primary care practices Specialty medical practices Multispecialty practices Urgent care centers Behavioral health practices Physical therapy and rehabilitation practices Outpatient healthcare organizations New medical practices requiring billing support Existing practices looking to outsource or change their billing company 
 Required Qualifications Experience in Business Development, Sales, or Client Acquisition . Strong preference for candidates with experience in Medical Billing, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Healthcare BPO, or Healthcare Sales . Understanding of the U.S. healthcare industry is strongly preferred. Ability to independently generate leads rather than relying only on company-provided leads. Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and follow-up skills. Comfortable with cold calling and outbound prospecting. Ability to communicate professionally with physicians, practice managers, and healthcare executives. Strong sales closing and relationship-building skills. Goal-oriented and comfortable working with monthly performance targets.

Experience selling any of the following is an advantage: Medical Billing Services Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Accounts Receivable / A/R Management Denial Management Credentialing Services Prior Authorization Services Healthcare Virtual Assistance / Back-Office Services Practice Management Services 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance may be measured based on: Number of new prospects contacted Qualified leads generated Sales meetings booked Proposals submitted Lead-to-client conversion rate New medical practices signed Monthly/quarterly revenue generated Client acquisition targets achieved Compensation 
 Salary: Rs. 60,000 - 80, 000/ Month 
 Incentives: 10% one-time commission based on the first month's cleared revenue from the successfully acquired client. 
 Ideal Candidate Our ideal BDM is someone who does not simply wait for inbound leads. 
 We are looking for a proactive business developer who knows how to find healthcare prospects, reach decision-makers, build relationships, consistently follow up, and convert opportunities into signed medical billing clients.
